column1: # content: the 4+4 model in its two forms: matter of a fixed total density (fixed number of particles per unit of the volume of the coordinates in which they move) while the couplings grow with the deflation clock
column2: g = g_threshold exp(tau_d); at each clock reading the state of lowest energy with respect to the polarization of the two halves

column3: 1 = Q; kF_total: Fermi momentum of the density with equal halves; tau_d: clock reading counted from the binding threshold of the same form
column4: set and dimension; g; pol; M_plus
column5: M_minus; eps: energy density; p: pressure along the coordinates in which the particles move; Pi: interaction pressure (the pressure along the deflating coordinates); e_bind: energy per particle minus m
